empty.purpose: Says the Library holds no tracks.

columns.title.purpose: Column heading for a track's title.

columns.artist.purpose: Column heading for a track's artist.

columns.file.purpose: Column heading for a track's file.

columns.actions.purpose: Accessible name of the actions column (visually hidden).
columns.actions.where: Library table header, last column (screen readers only).

fileMissing.purpose: Note that a track's file isn't on disk.
fileMissing.where: Library table, under the file path, for a track whose file is missing.

driveNotConnected.purpose: Note that a track's file is on a drive that isn't plugged in.
driveNotConnected.where: Library table, under the file path, for a track on a drive that isn't connected.

remove.button.purpose: Button that starts removing a track.
remove.button.where: Library table, last column of each row.

remove.buttonFor.purpose: Accessible name of a row's Remove button, naming the track.
remove.buttonFor.where: Library table, aria-label of each Remove button (screen readers; {{title}} is the track).

remove.conflicts_one.purpose: Warns that removing a track drops its one open conflict.
remove.conflicts_one.where: Library screen, remove confirmation, for a track with one open conflict.
remove.conflicts_one.approved: Its open conflict will be dropped

remove.conflicts_other.purpose: Warns that removing a track drops its open conflicts.
remove.conflicts_other.where: Library screen, remove confirmation, for a track with several open conflicts.
remove.conflicts_other.approved: Its {{count}} open conflicts will be dropped

remove.title.purpose: Asks to confirm removing a track.
remove.title.where: Library screen, remove confirmation dialog title ({{title}} is the track).

remove.detail.purpose: Says the removal can be undone.
remove.detail.where: Library screen, remove confirmation dialog, under the question.

remove.cancel.purpose: Button that backs out of the removal.
remove.cancel.where: Library screen, remove confirmation dialog (focused by default).

remove.done.where: Library screen, status strip above the list after a removal.

remove.undo.where: Library screen, status strip after a removal.

remove.undone.where: Library screen, status strip after an undo.

remove.undoRefused.purpose: Says the undo wasn't possible because the Library changed.
remove.undoRefused.where: Library screen, alert after an undo is refused.
remove.undoRefused.approved: Can't undo: the Library has changed since

fragile.downloads.purpose: Warns that a file in Downloads may be lost.
fragile.downloads.where: Library table, note under the file path for a file in a Downloads folder.
fragile.downloads.approved: In Downloads: will be lost if Downloads is cleared

fragile.temp.purpose: Warns that a file in a temp folder may be deleted by Windows.
fragile.temp.where: Library table, note under the file path for a file in a temp folder.
fragile.temp.approved: In a temp folder: Windows may delete it

fragile.external.purpose: Warns that a file on an external drive is lost when the drive is unplugged.
fragile.external.where: Library table, note under the file path for a file on an external drive.
fragile.external.approved: On an external drive: will be lost when the drive is unplugged

fragile.network.purpose: Warns that a file on a network drive is lost when the drive is offline.
fragile.network.where: Library table, note under the file path for a file on a network drive.
fragile.network.approved: On a network drive: will be lost when the drive is offline

error.trackNotFound.where: Shown where a Library command fails because the track wasn't found (any screen that shows command errors).

error.noFile.purpose: Error: the track can't be added because it has no file.
error.noFile.where: Shown where adding a track fails because the track has no file.
error.noFile.approved: Can't add: this track has no file

error.fileMissing.purpose: Error: the track can't be added because its file is missing.
error.fileMissing.where: Shown where adding a track fails because its file isn't on disk ({{path}} is the file).

error.matchNotConfirmed.purpose: Error: the track can't be added because one of its files is only the probable match of a rekordbox track, and matches can't be confirmed yet.
error.matchNotConfirmed.where: Shown where adding a track is refused for that reason. All music greys the button out instead, so this is the fallback if the add is asked for anyway.
error.matchNotConfirmed.approved: Can't add: this track's rekordbox match is uncertain
